scope: Source-verified operating-system and graphics API compatibility layers not already present in the catalog or staged additions. The two records cover Mesa Dozen's Vulkan-to-Direct3D 12 driver and DxWrapper's DirectDraw/Direct3D 1–7-to-Direct3D 9 feature. No database, generated catalog, or central manifest edits are included.

projects.title: Dozen (Mesa dzn Vulkan Driver)
projects.platform: Vulkan 1.2 applications in Linux userspace, commonly WSL2/WSLg, → Microsoft Direct3D 12 through Mesa's dzn ICD and DXCore adapter enumeration; requires a host D3D12-capable GPU/driver. Mesa also supports Windows builds.
projects.status: Active upstream Mesa driver; the current source advertises Vulkan 1.2 and emits Mesa's non-conformance warning. It is selected through Mesa's experimental microsoft-experimental Vulkan-driver build option and has no separate release stream.
projects.summary: Dozen (dzn) is Mesa's Vulkan implementation over Microsoft Direct3D 12. It exposes Vulkan to applications in Linux/WSL userspace where the backing host provides a D3D12 adapter; feature support depends on the D3D12 driver, and Mesa explicitly marks this implementation non-conformant.
projects.strategy: Vulkan ICD translates Vulkan 1.2 device work to Microsoft Direct3D 12 and DXCore.
projects.source_available: Public source in the Mesa repository; the dzn implementation is primarily C with C++ DXCore code. Vulkan application source code is not required.

projects.title: DxWrapper
projects.platform: DirectDraw and Direct3D 1–7 → Direct3D 9; Windows 10/11 host using a per-game proxy DLL and a D3D9-capable graphics driver.
projects.status: Active; latest listed release v1.9.8700.25 was published 2026-10-12. The maintainer's Dd7to9 notes say most DirectDraw APIs are implemented while Direct3D coverage remains limited; its game matrix reports compatibility per title.
projects.summary: A per-game DirectX compatibility wrapper for older Windows games. Its Dd7to9 feature converts DirectDraw and Direct3D 1–7 calls to Direct3D 9; DxWrapper also supplies compatibility fixes and integrates other wrapper projects, so this entry focuses on its distinct Dd7to9 translation path.
projects.strategy: A proxy DLL enables the Dd7to9 backend, which implements DirectDraw/Direct3D 1–7 over Direct3D 9; game-specific compatibility options are set in dxwrapper.ini.
projects.source_available: Public C/C++ source repository with binary releases. The game executable and data are user-supplied; no game source code is required.
projects.subtype: Legacy DirectX compatibility wrapper with DirectDraw/Direct3D-to-D3D9 translation
